svg.title: Student Attendance System - System Sequence Diagram

g.text: Student Attendance System - System Sequence Diagram
System boundary: React frontend + Express API + MySQL.
Internal calls are intentionally hidden in this system sequence diagram.
Successful login and database availability are assumed after authentication.
JWT (24 hours), lecturer profile and dashboard
Request mobile setup (course, date, start/end time)
Setup QR link with request ID and token (5-minute expiry)
Open setup link on phone and submit location
Status and submitted location when completed
Create session (course, date, start/end time, lecturer location)
[Course not owned by lecturer or an active session already exists]
Session details and attendance QR link
[Session used a completed mobile location request]
Open QR link (session ID, QR token)
JWT and student profile; return to QR page
Mark attendance and permit browser location access
[Location unavailable, denied, or reported accuracy exceeds 50 meters]
Explain location issue; no attendance submission
Frontend submits session ID, QR token, latitude and longitude.
API authenticates the JWT and requires the student role.
[Session/token invalid, closed or expired; lecturer location missing]
Reject attendance with session validation error
[Student was not enrolled when the session was created]
[Attendance already recorded for this student and session]
Reject attendance (403), distance and allowed radius
Attendance recorded (201), status present and distance
